content:
Heads up, baseball fans. MLB: The Show has officially launched on iPhone. If you want to play as your favorite MLB team on a gaming console, MLB: The Show is the name of the game. With the 20th anniversary of the game’s first release, MLB: The Show has arrived on iPhone for the first time.

MLB: The Show Mobile is now available for iPhone and Android

The game makers first started testing the game in the Philippines at the end of last year. Six months later, the title is now available globally in the App Store.

The game makers call it “a new standalone experience built from the ground up to deliver realistic baseball gameplay on mobile devices.”

For now, don’t expect cross-platform support between mobile and console versions. There’s also no iPad version.

MLB: The Show Mobile requires iOS 26 for the best experience. While older iPhones running iOS 26 are compatible, the game will feature “enhanced graphics, increased frame rates, and higher resolutions” on iPhone 16 and up.

You can download MLB: The Show for iPhone from the App Store today. MLB: The Show Mobile is also available for Android.
